thread:
Lina (Marketing): Heads-up: tomorrow's international webinar (11:00 PT) will have live interpretation (EN, FR, DE, JP). Need owners for: reg consent wording, Zoom interpretation settings, multi-lang SRT outputs, HubSpot language tags, and clip-translation SLA. Keep replies short.

Marco (Events): I'll run greenroom + local backup. Enabling Zoom 'Language Interpretation' with dedicated interpreter accounts. Will place interpreters in their own audio channels.

zoom-bot: Meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/666666666. Cloud recording enabled. Language interpretation enabled (en, fr, de, ja). Recording: host + separate interpreter audio tracks. Webhook target /hooks/zoom/intl-upload.

Eva (Ops): On uploads: we'll emit master MP4 + per-language SRTs when transcription job finishes (eng_transcript.srt, fr_transcript.srt ...). S3 path: s3://redwood-marketing/intl-webinar/2026-08-04/. Replay TTL: EU=7 days, US=14 days (legal requested).

legal-bot: Reminder: add explicit consent checkbox on registration: "I consent to recording and cross-border transfer of my data for the purposes of event delivery and marketing." Keep copy link to privacy policy.

Lina (Marketing): Reg copy draft: "You're registered — check your local time & add to calendar. By registering you agree to recording and data transfer (link). Select preferred language on the join page." Add a field for preferred_language on signup.

Samir (Growth): HubSpot mapping: preferred_language -> contact.c_preferred_language, tag=intl-webinar-2026, attended boolean. If preferred_language != en, set nurture_flow=localized. Also flag leads from EU domains as eu_region=true.

Hana (Content): I'll own subtitle QA + translated 90s clips (one per language). Need per-language SRT + markers.csv. Editors will request translated captions for social. SLA: 48 hours for highlights, 72 hours for translated full SRTs.

Eva (Ops): Webhook payload will include s3_master_mp4, s3_transcripts (list of URLs), markers_csv, preferred_language, company_domain, region=eu/us, replay_url_ttl_days (per-region). We'll also set "release_form_signed" if speaker release exists.

Marco (Events): Greenroom checklist add-ons: interpreter mic check, interpreter names in Zoom roster for caption alignment, ensure live-language dropdown visible in join email. I'll be in 45m early.

Lina (Marketing): Legal confirmed EU TTL=7. Also, add short consent copy to confirmation email and a link to request deletion. We'll put localized replay copy in the follow-up.

Samir (Growth): For workflows: attended -> localized replay + short survey in their language; no-show -> localized replay drip. Add property "survey_completed" for gating full downloads.

Hana (Content): Recap owners: Marco=greenroom/local backup+interpreters, Eva=upload+transcripts+webhook, Hana=edits+translated-clips, Samir=HubSpot mapping+drips, Lina=copy+consent. All set? :simple_smile:

Lina (Marketing): Perfect. If no objections I'll publish final reg copy and enable preferred_language field now. Thanks everyone.
